headline: Approved September 2026 minutes and reviewed project calendar and FY27 budget of $45,000.00
summary: The commission approved the September 2026 meeting minutes. Members heard a report from the Grant Subcommittee on changes to the grant application process and discussed a draft project calendar and brainstorm list for the fiscal year through June 2027.
decisions: Approved the September 2026 meeting minutes, with one abstention.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion to Approve was made by Jane and seconded by Jenn, Chuck abstained, all others in favor. Motion carried.

Nashua Arts Commission 
Meeting minutes 
Oct. 13, 2026 
In attendance: 
Jennifer Annand 
Sara Ceaser 
Chuck Emmons 
Faith Mandravelis 
Jane Marquis 
Mike McDowell  
Stephanie Moll 
Lindsay Rinaldi 
Lauren Spira-Savett
Absent: Tina Cassidy, Paula Lochhead 
City reps: Liz Hannum, Alderman-at-Large Morgan, Kathleen Palmer 
Guest: Kathy Prevost, potential commissioner candidate 
 
Call to Order: 8:04 am. Roll Call of Members. 
Motion to Approve: Sept. 2026 minutes – Motion to Approve was made by Jane and seconded by Jenn, 
Chuck abstained, all others in favor. Motion carried. 
Grant Subcommittee Report: Laurie gave an overview of their first meeting, which included making small 
changes to the grant submission form and process. These changes will be approved and given to City rep 
Kathleen to change before the form goes live for the grant season. The subcom’s next meeting will include 
reviewing the evaluation rubric, a formal appointment of the new Chair to overtake outgoing Chair Jenn, and 
creating a firm marketing plan for getting the word out. Attached below are the meeting Minutes. 
Priorities and Project Planning for the fiscal year:  Lindsay and the commissioners brainstormed potential 
projects and broke them out by month to the end of this fiscal year (June 2027). Attached below are the projects 
proposed and a draft calendar. 
Action Items for all commissioners: 
• Review drafted project calendar and master brainstorm list and choose at least one project you'd like to 
be actively involved in.   
• Identify anything that was missed and bring up at next meeting 
• Review NAC Arts & Culture Plan and match your preferred project to an initiative in the plan and 
consider the "why"/impact 
Motion to Adjourn: 9:20 am, made by Chuck, seconded by Jenn, all in favor. Motion carried. 
Next Meeting:  8 am Tuesday, Nov. 10, 2026
